2200. Counting Letters, Digits, and Spaces in a Sentence

40

Medium

Problem Statement
Read a sentence and count how many letters, digits, and spaces it contains, using a character array and an if-else-if ladder.

Description
Read a full line of text into a character array using fgets. Use a loop to examine each character until the end of the line. Use an if-else-if ladder to check whether the character is a letter (between 'a' and 'z', or between 'A' and 'Z'), a digit (between '0' and '9'), or a space, and increase the matching counter. Any other character is ignored. Print the number of letters, the number of digits, and the number of spaces, each on its own line.
input_spec: A single line of text containing at most 100 characters.
output_spec: Print the number of letters, the number of digits, and the number of spaces, each on its own line.
